candidates.behavior_change: Merged change updates 2 camera source file(s) in platform/frameworks/support +68/-5: Clear Recorder.mActiveSurface on surface release. Commit message: When VideoEncoderSession's surface terminates and getReadyToReleaseFuture() completes before onSourceStateChangedInternal(SourceState.INACTIVE) runs on mSequentialExecutor, Recorder.onResetVideo() resets the video encoder session and clears mNeedsResetBeforeNextStart, but previously left mActiveSurface pointing to the released Surface.
